# UX and Safety Checklist: Connections manager (environment level)

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements of feature 024: are the UX and graphics requirements, the safety of the deletion, the honesty of the dependency wording and the compliance rules complete, clear, consistent and measurable?
**Created**: 2026-11-11
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) (plan: [plan.md](../plan.md), tasks: [tasks.md](../tasks.md))

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Depth**: standard, for the author as reviewer before `/speckit-implement`. **Focus**: UX and graphics, safety of the deletion, honesty of the dependency wording, constitution and independence.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the visual states of a connection row (default, hovered, focused, selected, ineligible, opened, loading dependencies) all named, or only the happy path? [Completeness, Spec §US1, §FR-2402]
- [ ] CHK002 Are requirements defined for a row whose dependencies failed to read (what the row shows, what the figure counts, how to retry)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-2404, §FR-2406]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the behaviour of a list refresh while Check all or an open dependency read is running specified, rather than only left to the plan? [Gap, Plan §Design 3]
- [ ] CHK004 Is it specified what happens to the ticked selection when the list is refreshed, filtered or searched (kept, dropped, shown in a count)? [Gap, Spec §FR-2413]
- [ ] CHK005 Are keyboard requirements defined for the whole area (reaching a row, opening it, ticking it, the filters, the dialog) and not only "keyboard reachable"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-2415]
- [ ] CHK006 Are focus requirements defined for opening and closing the deletion dialog and for the busy state (where focus goes, that it never jumps to the top)? [Gap, Spec §FR-2414]
- [ ] CHK007 Are light and dark theme requirements stated for the status chips (contrast that does not rely on colour alone) in measurable terms? [Measurability, Spec §FR-2415]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the paging of the list (the size of a page, "Show more") a requirement in the spec, or only a decision in the plan? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases, Plan §Performance Goals]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK009 Is "a rich, graphic list" translated into concrete, checkable elements (which fields, which tile, which chip) so a reviewer can tell when it is met? [Ambiguity, Spec §US1, §FR-2402]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "works from a narrow window" quantified with a width, or defined by what must remain usable? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-2415]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "a few at a time" for Check all given a number in the spec (the plan says 4), and is the reason stated? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-2407]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the coverage note's required content testable (which sentences must appear, in which cases), not only "names the sources"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-2406]
- [ ] CHK013 Are the three status words (Connected, Needs reconnect, Error) defined by the data that produces them, with Unknown named as the fourth outcome? [Clarity, Spec §FR-2402, Research §D-5]
- [ ] CHK014 Is "Could not be checked" defined distinctly from "No dependency found" and from "In use" in every place the three appear? [Consistency, Spec §US3, §FR-2406]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the term "broken" defined once (Needs reconnect or Error) and used the same way in the figure, the filter and the selection rule? [Consistency, Spec §FR-2403, §US3]

## Honesty of the Dependency Wording

- [ ] CHK016 Does every place that shows a connection with nothing found use the same wording, and is the word "unused" excluded in the spec and in the acceptance scenarios? [Consistency, Spec §FR-2406]
- [ ] CHK017 Is it specified that the deletion Preview repeats the coverage limits (a not-scanned flow source, unreadable apps) and not only the warning that the deletion is permanent? [Completeness, Spec §FR-2409, Research §D-3]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the visibility limit (the connections the signed-in user can see) stated wherever the total is shown, and is it consistent with the Input's "ALL connections"? [Conflict, Spec §OP-3, §FR-2401]
- [ ] CHK019 Are the cases where a source answers "none" because the user lacks the right to see (not because there is none) distinguished from a real "none" in the requirements? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the rule that a flow that cannot be read blocks selection consistent between the edge cases and FR-2406, which names only failed sources? [Conflict, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-2406]

## Safety of the Deletion

- [ ] CHK021 Is the switch's lifecycle specified end to end: who may turn it on, on what evidence, and that the evidence is recorded where a test can read it? [Completeness, Spec §FR-2411, Research §D-4]
- [ ] CHK022 Is it specified that with the switch off no code path can delete, as a requirement a test can fail on, and not only as an intent? [Measurability, Spec §FR-2411, §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK023 Are the unlock requirements (code, acknowledgement) specified with their exact properties (changes every time the dialog opens, cannot be bypassed by pressing Enter, what happens if the dialog is closed and reopened)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-2410]
- [ ] CHK024 Is the content of the backup file specified field by field, with the statement that no secret is read, and is the place and name of the saved file left to the user explicitly? [Completeness, Spec §FR-2410]
- [ ] CHK025 Are the per-row checks before the write (still exists, still no dependency found) and after it (gone from the list) defined with the exact message each produces? [Clarity, Spec §FR-2409]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the partial-failure behaviour defined (some rows done, some skipped, the route refused midway) including what the Result says and whether the list is read again? [Coverage, Spec §US4, §FR-2409]
- [ ] CHK027 Is a deletion refused by the service for rights or protection (not the route) distinguished in the requirements from a route that does not exist? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK028 Are the consequences for a shared connection and for references that still hold its id stated in the Preview requirements, not only in the edge cases? [Completeness, Spec §US4, §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK029 Is it specified that the deletion works on a snapshot of the dependency answers and that a connection read before a refresh can no longer be deleted from the old answer? [Gap, Spec §FR-2407, §FR-2409]

## UX of Waits and Disabled State

- [ ] CHK030 Is "every wait longer than a second shows what is happening" measurable (the threshold, what counts as real progress versus an indeterminate spinner for each wait: list, row, Check all, apply)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007, §FR-2414]
- [ ] CHK031 Is the rule "every button disabled while an action runs" stated for the new area including which control keeps its look and spinner, consistent with the constitution's T8? [Consistency, Spec §FR-2414]
- [ ] CHK032 Is the cancel of Check all specified as the one control that stays enabled during it, and is the cancel of the initial list read (or its absence) specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-2407]
- [ ] CHK033 Are scroll and focus preservation requirements defined for each redraw trigger (a dependency read finishing, a filter change, Show more) and not only for Refresh? [Coverage, Spec §FR-2413]

## Constitution and Independence

- [ ] CHK034 Does the spec require the constitution amendment to be part of the feature and say what it must contain (scope, the new read door, the flag), so the amendment can be checked? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK035 Is the rule "no other tool is named" applied to every artifact the feature adds (README, CHANGELOG, tests, commit messages, research), not only to the code? [Coverage, Spec §Input constraints]
- [ ] CHK036 Are the privacy rules (names, ids and emails on screen only, never logged) stated for the new log lines and for the backup file, which does contain names and creators? [Conflict, Spec §FR-2417, §FR-2410]

## Notes

- Items are about the requirements as written in spec.md, plan.md and tasks.md; nothing here tests the implementation.
- CHK018, CHK020 and CHK036 mark places where two parts of the spec may disagree; resolve them in the spec (and tick) before `/speckit-implement`.
- The live checks (OP-1 to OP-3) are tracked in `quickstart.md` and are not part of this checklist.
- `/speckit-implement` reads the state of the markers and does not modify them.
